levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Labels fewer than two of the three messages' audiences correctly, or does not identify which message is mismatched.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correctly labels all three messages' intended audiences and identifies Message C as the mismatched one.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Correctly labels all three audiences, identifies the mismatch, and names the specific wording (slang, abbreviations, missing greeting) that causes it.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Rewrites Message C but keeps casual wording (slang, abbreviations) or does not name any specific changes made.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Rewrites Message C into an appropriately formal register and names at least two specific wording changes.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Rewrites Message C into an appropriately formal register, names at least three specific wording changes, and explains what register signal each change removes or adds.

lookFors: A rewritten Message C that removes every slang term ('lol', 'my bad') and adds a named greeting and closing.
A specific, word-level comparison between the casual and formal versions rather than a general statement like 'I made it more polite.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
